name: rail-live-band-rows-phone
description: Live rows on the touch board: names lead the band and secondary text even when selected, titles align, and the why line truncates a single line below its title

mutation.note: Without nowrap the long why text wraps and the .why box grows past one caption line. On 2026-11-24 the old title-only button put the reason 29.59px below the name for an 18.2px line. Inside one target without the column layout, their centers were just 0.5px apart. Both failed.
